560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.definition: The state of being able to make the decision of commitment now, with the time, the wish and a picture of the cost.
560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.gloss: The state of being able to make the decision of commitment now, with the time, the wish and a picture of the cost.
今の時点で継続を決断できる状態。

560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.definition: 필요한 시간이 있고 마음이 준비되었으며 비용을 분명히 알고 있어 지금 약속을 결정할 수 있는 상태. 마음이 들었다는 것과 결정을 내릴 준비가 되었다는 것은 다르므로 둘을 구분해야 한다.
560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.gloss: 필요한 시간과 의지와 비용에 대한 그림을 가지고 지금 결정을 내릴 수 있는 상태.

560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.definition: Condição de estar apto a assumir o compromisso no momento presente, reunindo três coisas: tempo disponível, vontade e consciência do preço a pagar. Ter vontade, sozinha, não basta.
560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.gloss: O estado de poder decidir agora o compromisso, com tempo, vontade e uma ideia clara do custo.

560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.definition: Kesiapan untuk berkomitmen adalah kondisi ketika seseorang memiliki waktu, keinginan, dan gambaran yang jelas tentang pengorbanan yang diperlukan untuk mengambil keputusan. Having dorongan saja belum berarti ia siap.
560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.gloss: Kondisi sudah mampu memutuskan untuk berkomitmen saat itu juga.

560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.definition: ภาวะที่บุคคลมีเวลา แรงปรารถนา และเห็นต้นทุนของการตัดสินใจอย่างชัดเจน จึงพร้อมตัดสินใจรับผิดชอบได้ทันที
560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.gloss: ความพร้อมที่จะตัดสินใจรับผิดชอบในขณะนี้

560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.definition: Bir kişinin taahhüt etmeye hazır olduğunu gösteren ruhsal durum. Bu hâlde yeterli zaman bulunur, istek güçlüdür ve taahhüdün bedeli anlaşılmıştır.
560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.gloss: Şimdi taahhüt etmeye karar verebilecek kadar istek, zaman ve maliyet kavrayışına sahip olma hâli.

560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.translation: İsteği vardı ama taahhüt etmeye hazır değildi; bu ikisini birbirinden ayırt edebiliyordu.
เขามีความปรารถนาที่จะรับผิดชอบแล้ว แต่ยังไม่มีความพร้อมในการตัดสินใจ
Ia sudah memiliki keinginan untuk berkomitmen, tetapi belum memiliki kesiapan untuk mengambil keputusan itu.
Ele tem a vontade, mas não a prontidão, e sabe distinguir uma coisa da outra.
그는 마음은 들었지만 결정을 내릴 준비는 아직 되지 않았으며, 그 둘을 구분할 수 있다.
彼には意思はある prepares no...

560ba3e215f8962f8b2501d3274b3be29751a249.text: He has the wish and not the readiness, and he can tell the two apart.

56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.definition: A huge group of tiny water drops, or ice crystals, floating together high in the air.
56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.gloss: A huge group of tiny water drops, or ice crystals, floating together high in the air.

56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.definition: 非常に小さな水滴や氷の結晶が空に集まってできたもの。雲は空にあるが、雨が必ず降るとは限らない。
56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.gloss: 空に浮かぶ水の粒や氷の結晶の集まり。

56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.definition: 공기 중에 매우 작은 물방울이나 얼음 결정이 모여 천공에 보이는 덩어리다. 구름은 안개보다 높이에서 물방울이 모인 것으로 설명할 수 있다.
56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.gloss: 공중에 함께 떠 있는 작은 물방울이나 얼음 결정의 무리.

56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.definition: Massa de gotículas de água e cristais de gelo suspensa na atmosfera. Quando há muitas nuvens no céu, a cobertura delas pode bloquear a luz do sol.
56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.gloss: Grande agrupamento de gotículas de água ou cristais de gelo no céu.

56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.definition: Kumpulan besar tetesan air atau kristal es yang melayang bersama-sama tinggi di udara. Awan terbentuk ketika uap air mengembun di atmosfer.
56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.gloss: Sekumpulan tetesan air atau kristal es yang melayang di langit.

56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.definition: กลุ่มของหยดน้ำหรือผลึกน้ำแข็งจำนวนมากที่รวมตัวและลอยอยู่สูงในอากาศ เมฆที่มีน้ำมากกว่าจะมองเห็นเป็นสีเทาหรือเข้ม
56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.gloss: กลุ่มหยดน้ำหรือผลึกน้ำแข็งจำนวนมากที่ลอยสูงในอากาศ

56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.definition: Atmosferde yüksekte bulunan su damlalarından veya buz kristallerinden oluşan büyük kümedir.
56681010b753e1abe52c449d0aab291b28f1808a.gloss: Havada birlikte yüzen çok sayıda küçük su damlası veya buz kristali.

56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.definition: A situation in which a person is given two rules that cannot both be satisfied.
56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.gloss: A situation in which a person is given two rules that cannot both be satisfied.

56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.definition: ある人が、両方を同時に守れない二つの指示や規則を与えられた状況。どちらを選んでも_rule に反することになる.
56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.gloss: 互いに矛盾する二つの規則を同時に課された状況。

56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.definition: 두 규칙을 동시에 제시받았지만 어느 쪽도 만족시킬 수 없는 상황을 말한다. 둘 중 하나만 선택하면 또 다른 규칙을 어기는 결과가 생긴다.
56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.gloss: 상반되거나 양립할 수 없는 두 요구를 동시에 당해지는 상황.

56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.definition: Situação em que uma pessoa recebe duas instruções incompatíveis e não consegue cumprir nenhuma delas sem violar a outra.
56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.gloss: Situação com duas exigências que não podem ser satisfeitas ao mesmo tempo.

56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.definition: Situasi ketika seseorang diberi dua aturan atau tuntutan yang saling bertentangan sehingga tidak dapat dipenuhi bersamaan.
56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.gloss: Situasi ketika seseorang diberi dua tuntutan yang tidak dapat dipenuhi sekaligus.

56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.definition: สถานการณ์ที่คนหนึ่งถูกสั่งให้ทำสองอย่างที่ขัดกันจนทำพร้อมกันไม่ได้ ไม่ว่าจะเลือกทางใดทางหนึ่งก็ยังถูกมองว่าผิด จึงเป็นสถานการณ์ที่ออกจากไม่ได้
56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.gloss: สถานการณ์ที่ได้รับกฎสองข้อซึ่งทำตามได้ไม่พร้อมกัน

56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.definition: Bir kişinin aynı anda uyması gereken, ancak birbiriyle çelişen iki talimatla karşılaştığı durum. İki kuraldan yalnızca biri yerine getirilebilir.
56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.gloss: Birbirini karşılayamayan iki kuralın aynı kişiye verildiği durum.

56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.translation: Bu bir çifte bağdır: Kararı sen vereceksin, ama herkesin yorulduğunu da sen fark edeceksin.
นี่คือกับดักสองข้าง: ต้องเป็นคนตัดสินใจ และต้องเป็นคนที่สังเกตว่าทุกคนเหนื่อยล้าหมด

これはダブルバインドだ。決める役，解决 and be the one who notices that everybody is exhausted.

56a7cfa52c4b1c44d934c5a2f74a351912f983ea.text: A double bind: be the one who decides, and be the one who notices that everybody is exhausted.

56ba7e20ea86e65b9c63cf4f5a6354f82423638a.definition: Power that other people accept and act on: the right to be followed.
56ba7e20ea86e65b9c63cf4f5a6354f82423638a.gloss: Power that other people accept and act on: the right to be followed.

56ba7e20ea86e65b9c63cf4f5a6354f82423638a.definition: 権威とは、他者が受け入れ、その指示や判断に従って行動する権力のことである。
56ba7e20ea86e65b9c63cf4f5a6354f82423638a.gloss: 他者が受け入れ、従う権力。

56ba7e20ea86e65b9c63cf4f5a6354f82423638a.definition: 사람들이 권위 있는 사람으로 인정하고 그 결정이나 지시에 따르는 권리다. 반드시 공식적인 직책이나 법적 권한을 뜻하지는 않는다.
A capacidade de conduzir outras pessoas, que elas reconhecem e respeitam. Não se confunda com poder coercivo: aqui o acento está no reconhecimento, não na força nem no medo.
56ba7e20ea86e65b9c63cf4f5a6354f82423638a.gloss: Poder que as outras pessoas aceitam e do qual obedecem: o direito de ser seguido.

56ba7e20ea86e65b9c63cf4f5a6354f82423638a.definition: Kewenangan yang diakui dan patihi oleh orang lain, sehingga seseorang berhak mengatur, memerintah, atau diikuti. Kata ini menunjuk bentuk kekuasaan yang diberikan oleh pihak lain, bukan kekuatan pribadi.
56ba7e20ea86e65b9c63cf4f5a6354f82423638a.gloss: Kewenangan yang diakui dan patihi oleh orang lain.

56ba7e20ea86e65b9c63cf4f5a6354f82423638a.definition: O kişinin söylediğini başkalarının soru sormadan yerine getirdiği güçtür. Yasal ya da resmî olmak zorunda değildir; alanı dar olabilir, yani bir konuda otorite var iken başka bir konuda olmayabilir.

56ba7e20ea86e65b9c63cf4f5a6354f82423638a.translation: Ông có quyền kiểm soát cỗ máy, nhưng không có quyền kiểm soát lịch trình.

56ccc4dcfc96534b06fc0c08a301be24f13b4914.gloss: The polite word you say before you ask for something. It shows you are asking, not taking.

56ccc4dcfc96534b06fc0c08a301be24f13b4914.gloss: 何かをお願いするときに使う、丁寧な言葉。

56ccc4dcfc96534b06fc0c08a301be24f13b4914.definition: “Por favor” é uma expressão usada antes ou depois de um pedido para mostrar cortesia. Ela não transforma o pedido em uma obrigação, mas também não garante que o outro pessoa concordará.
56ccc4dcfc96534b06fc0c08a301be24f13b4914.gloss: Palavra usada para fazer um pedido de maneira educada.

56ccc4dcfc96534b06fc0c08a301be24f13b4914.definition: Kata “tolong” atau “mohon” menunjukkan bahwa seseorang meminta, bukan mengambil dengan paksa. Ungkapan ini umum dipakai untuk meminta bantuan atau izin.

56db37235e30c0bb736e38ebed1bfe71fee5bbb9.definition: The line where the two sides stand against each other, and the whole stretch of fighting behind it.
56db37235e30c0bb736e38ebed1bfe71fee5bbb9.gloss: The line where the two sides stand against each other, and the whole stretch of fighting behind it.

56db37235e30c0bb736e38ebed1bfe71fee5bbb9.definition: 両軍が向かい合う位置である前線と、そこでの戦闘を含む戦域。PRODUCT意义上的には、战线全体を指すこともある。

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.gloss: The material a model learned from. Its coverage and quality decide where the model is strong and where it invents things.

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.definition: 学習データの範囲と質がモデルの得意・不得足を左右し、不足した内容を架空に補って生成する原因にもなる。
56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.gloss: モデルが学習に用いた資料。

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.definition: 모델이 학습하는 데 사용된 데이터이다. 자료가 어디까지 포괄되고 얼마나 좋은지에 따라 모델의 성능과 정확한回答 능력이 달라진다.

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.gloss: Conjunto de informações usado para ensinar um modelo.

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.definition: Data pelatihan mencakup materi yang dipelajari model. Cakupan dan kualitasnya menentukan bidang yang dikuasai model serta bagian yang mungkin dikarang.
56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.gloss: Data yang digunakan model untuk mempelajari pola.

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.gloss: ข้อมูลที่ใช้ฝึกโมเดลให้เรียนรู้รูปแบบต่าง ๆ

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.definition: Bir modelin öğrenmek için kullandığı veri. Verinin kapsamı ve kalitesi, modelin hangi konularda güçlü olduğunu ve nerede bilgi uydurduğunu belirler.
56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.gloss: Bir modelin öğrenmek için kullandığı veri.

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.text: The model's weakness on local rules comes from what the training data never covered.
56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.translation: Modelin yerel kurallar konusundaki zayıflığı, eğitim verisinin hiç ele almadığı konulardan kaynaklanıyor.

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.text: The model's weakness on local rules comes from what the training data never covered.

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.text: The model's weakness on local rules comes from what the training data never covered.
56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.translation: Kelemahan model terhadap aturan setempat berasal dari data pelatihan yang tidak pernah memuatnya.

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.text: The model's weakness on local rules comes from what the training data never covered.
56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.translation: A fraqueza do modelo diante das regras locais ocorre porque os dados de treinamento não cobriram esse tema.

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.text: The model's weakness on local rules comes from what the training data never covered.
56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.translation: 모델이 지역 규칙에 약한 것은 학습 데이터에 그 내용이 포함되지 않았기 때문입니다.

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.text: The model's weakness on local rules comes from what the training data never covered.
56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.translation: このモデルが地域の規則に弱いのは、学習データに相关内容 がなかったためです。

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.definition: The text a model learns from. Its range and its quality decide what the model is good at and what it never saw.
56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.gloss: The text a model learns from. Its range and its quality decide what the model is good at and what it never saw.

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.gloss: モデルが学習する文章のこと。

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.definition: 학습 자료의 범위와 품질이 모델이 잘하는 분야와 보지 못한 내용을 결정합니다. 특정 언어나 주제가 충분히 포함되지 않으면 그쪽에 대한 성능이 낮아질 수 있습니다.
Conjunto de textos, imagens ou outros dados usados para ensinar um modelo. A variedade e a qualidade desses dados influenciam o que o modelo aprende e em que situações ele pode ter Bom desempenho.
56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.gloss: O texto que um modelo aprende durante o treinamento.

56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.definition: Teks yang dipelajari sebuah model bahasa atau sistem kecerdasan buatan. Cakupannya yang luas atau sempit serta mutunya yang tinggi atau rendah menentukan apa yangdikuasai model dan apa yang tidak pernah dilihatnya.
56eabe5e6f9e24db830b8652b9adcd9aa56e3cd1.gloss: Teks yang dipelajari sebuah model, yang cakupannya dan mutunya menentukan kemampuan model tersebut.
